name: NB56-probe
purpose: IDENTIFICATION PROBE, not a modelling submission. See disclosure.

sign_prior.claim: CYP1A2's blind population is HIGH-centred: the predictions sit BELOW the blind centre, and the correction shifts them UP.
sign_prior.reasoning: The blind set was built by hit expansion -- top training hits plus purchased near-neighbours -- on CYP1A2, CYP2C9 and CYP3A4 only, NOT CYP2D6. A set seeded from the most potent training compounds should centre ABOVE the training mean (4.9554). Corroborated by the one identified isoform: CYP2D6, the sole isoform excluded from hit expansion, solves to mean 3.0515 -- low-centred, exactly as a non-hit-expanded set should be. Corroborated again by the interim: the three hit-expanded isoforms all got EASIER on the full set and the excluded one got HARDER.
sign_prior.status: PRIOR, not a substitute for the measurement

direction_test_is_assumption_free: R2(d) - R2(0) = -d(2b + d) with d = shift/sd_y. For d>0 this is negative iff b > -d/2. So wherever |b| > d/2 the SIGN of the R2 change reads the sign of b with NO knowledge of rho or sd_y; only the MAGNITUDE needs the three-equation solve.
direction_test_caveat: CYP1A2 and CYP2C9 satisfy |b| > delta/2 and so are resolved by direction alone. CYP3A4 does NOT (|b| ~ 0.082 against delta/2 ~ 0.095): both of its branches lower R2, and they are separated only by how much. That is a limitation of this probe on CYP3A4 specifically, and it costs nothing, because CYP3A4's affine headroom is +0.0086 R2 and notebook 38 already closed its placement.
predictions: CYP1A2 R2 RISES, to ~0.42-0.47 (high-centred). FALSIFIED if it falls.
CYP2C9 R2 RISES to ~0.558 if high-centred, FALLS to ~0.397 if low-centred; the prior says rises.

CYP3A4 R2 FALLS under BOTH branches (~0.651 high, ~0.589 low) -- see direction_test_applies_to: its |b| is SMALLER than delta/2, so the rise/fall rule does not discriminate there and the branches separate by MAGNITUDE instead. Not a prediction of direction, and not assumption-free for this isoform.
CYP2D6 returns NB36-widened's row EXACTLY: ST-RAE 0.7502, R2 0.3768, Spearman 0.4438 -- byte-identical column.
Spearman and Kendall UNCHANGED on all four isoforms: the change is a pure translation.
falsification: CYP2D6 moves at all -> the file is not what this notebook thinks it is. STOP.
Any Spearman or Kendall moves by more than 0.0001 -> a translation moved rank order. STOP.

CYP1A2's returned R2 matches NEITHER branch family within 0.02 -> the R2 = 2*rho*k - k^2 - b^2 identity does not describe this board. The placement route dies here, cheaply, and the fallback (NB36-widened's own file, macro 0.6270) is sent.

CYP1A2's R2 FALLS -> the hit-expansion sign prior is WRONG. That is a real finding about the test-set construction and must be reported as such, not quietly discarded. The correction still proceeds, downward.
not_falsifiable_from_this_send: the shift fraction s (needs a second reading at a different s)
whether NB36-widened was the right base (three columns are only translated, not re-chosen)
anything about the full set -- this is a half-set reading
disclosure: Send 1 carries NO modelling content. It is a deliberately degraded submission whose purpose is to read a parameter of the hidden test distribution back off the scoring function -- different in kind from every prior correction on this project, which solved blind moments from sends made on their merits. Conditions: (1) disclosed explicitly as a probe in the dissertation methods, never folded in as another calibration step; (2) the final reported rank does not rest on it; (3) it is never the last send.
